notes.title: Faye Falling is 35% Off + New Update!
notes.notes:
The third major update for my game Faye Falling is out now! The new update features an expanded Challenge Mode, improved backtracking, new secrets, new rings, trial rewards, QOL updates, improved performance, the ability to equip two rings at once, and lots more!

Faye Falling is also 35% off for the next two weeks, so make sure to grab it if you haven't yet!

[previewyoutube=Kq-HPECdqn4;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865750/Faye_Falling/

If you haven't checked it out yet, Faye is very much a spiritual successor to View From Below. It takes everything I did with this game and makes it so much better. It features 5 endings, 6 bosses (+1 secret boss), 3 gameplay paths, an original soundtrack with 30 songs, and lots more!

More soon,
Jack

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.63
notes.notes:
A new build for View From Below is now available. Version 1.63 was released on the 8th of January with a few important fixes for bugs introduced in 1.62. (Hopefully I managed to fix it all up before anyone ran into them.)

These are the (short) patch notes:

Patch Notes
-Fixed the game acting glitchy during certain story events
-Fixed some rare crashes

If you have any issues, feedback or questions, feel free to leave a post on the steam forum.

That's all for now,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.62
notes.notes:
A new small, though important, update for View From Below is up now. It adds 2 new minigames to give the Abyss consoles more variety, as well as some other cool little improvements and additions. It also fixes a rare glitch introduced in the last update that'd stop the correct cutscene music from playing, and some scenes not playing out correctly when mashing the confirm and cancel keys really fast.

Full Patch Notes:
New Abyss Minigames
-The 1st computer now has a brick breaker mini game
-The 2nd computer now has a Snake minigame
-The 3rd computer has the original block-matching minigame, with a minor visual bug fixed

Tweaks and Fixes
-Improved balancing
-Fixed an issue where the correct music wouldn't play in some cutscenes after a battle or screen change
If you have any issues, feedback or questions, feel free to leave a post on the steam forum.

Thanks,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.61
notes.notes:
A quick, small patch for View From Below is up now. It has some small improvements, as well as some minor bug fixes. 

Patch Notes:
-Made the attack bar smaller horizontally
-Improved spell casting balancing
-Added and changed some overworld music
-Improved flashback 6 and 7 cutscene artwork
-Some visual improvements
-Fixed some minor bugs

If you have any issues, feedback or questions, feel free to leave a post on the steam forum.

Happy Holidays, and thanks so much for playing. I'll be announcing my next game ASAP, I'm really excited about it!

-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Hey! I just released a new major update for View From Below. It adds some new features like GamePad rumble, the ability to set GamePad button prompts and in-game online leaderboards, as well as lots of refinement and polish across the entire game, such as new Rose chase sequences, and improved tilesets. Here are the full patch notes:

Patch Notes:
New Features

 Full GamePad support with button label settings, and rumble
 Added in-game online leaderboards

New Rose Attack Patterns

 Sequence 1 was remade
 Sequence 2; the swords now spin, and spawn closer to the player
 Sequence 3; the beams now spawn from Xs, and swords occasionally also spawn

Tweaks

 Improved screens and menus
 Pacing improvements to Chapter 1 and 3
 Important fix to balancing to avoid the late-game balance issue
 Renamed The Runes of Truth to “The Abyss of Truth”
 Improved some jokes
 Visual improvements, such as new weather effects and improved tilesets
 Made characters refer to the MC as “mortal” instead of “human”
 Added the ability to turn Alternative Sync on or off, and a "reset" button
 Osseus has a new attack pattern with 2 forms
 HP and Mana bars now ease in and out smoothly, and fade to black after the character faints

Bug Fixes

 Fixed melody’s armor not always lowering the damage she takes
 Changed some performance settings to fix lag on the latest Windows update (this update was made quietly pre-patch)


If you have any feedback, or run into any issues, please let me know in the community forums or in a comment below.

As usual, here's the trailer once more (I'll be updating it to reflect 1.6 soon):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d7kOWq6lN7k&feature=emb_title

I'm really proud of the game now, so updates will likely slow down as I shift focus to my next project (I'll announce it soon!)

I really want to thank everyone that has played the game so far- all of your support, messages and feedback has really meant a lot to me. This was the first real game I've ever made, so to have so many people actually enjoy it has been such an amazing feeling.

Be well,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I just finished up another update for View From Below. While it adds a few new things, it was mainly focused on polishing up some visuals and story sequences. I'll be releasing 1 more major update sometime in December- but for now I can safely say that the game is *very* much all finished and polished up. If you do have any feedback or suggestions though, make sure to let me know!

Patch Notes:
New Content

 Added some final new achievements
 Added 3 more Shady Traders selling powerful items
 Added 2 new minigames for attack training and eating mana berries
 Added an Iron Mask blacksmith
 Added 3 additional stats to the spy log: perfect attacks, owl flights and coins collected


Tweaks

 Refined the broken bridge scene in chapter 1
 Major dialogue improvements
 Added a small screen shake when puzzles are finished or levers are flipped
 Increased the intensity of the brightness setting
 Finally chose a good sound for Bell's voice LOL
 Talking sound effects now play when the name of the talker is hidden
 Added a proper error message if a text file fails to load due to a broken installation


Important Bug Fix

 Fixed the game soft locking before the final boss fight if you get to the event right before it, and then back tracking and doing another battle


...Phew! Quite a lot! If you have any feedback, or run into any issues, please let me know in the community forums!

Here's an updated version of the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d7kOWq6lN7k&feature=emb_title

Thanks,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Following 2 recent small updates - 1.31 and 1.32 - today I'm really excited to announce that the biggest update for View From Below yet is up now! It includes new content, new features, new secrets, and lots of polish and refinement throughout the game.

Here are some of the updates:
New Content

 Added some new achievements
 Added The Fountain of Riches and Secret Igloo to Glacies
 Added a Blacksmith
 Added new types of coins, and a new type of chest called a Chance Chest
 Added a new song that plays inside ice caves

Tweaks

 Improved map design
 Made Challenge Mode harder (hehehehe...)
 Improved some dialogue, and toned down some meme-y-ness
 Added NPCS you met through out your journey to the 2nd last room, congratulating you on your victory
 Lots of visual improvements, such as Bell attacking with treasure instead of coins
 Bell has a new talking sound effect
 Fixed some tiny bugs


You can check out the full patch notes in the community forums here. If you have any suggestions or feedback, make sure to post it in the community forums, in a review, or in a comment below! I might take it on board for a future update.

Here's the trailer once more:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0AlYpDLNVls

Thanks so much to every one who has played View From Below so far- I hope the new updates will make your current play through, or your future play throughs, that much more enjoyable.

Be well,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I'm back again with another major update for View From Below. Launching just over 3 months ago, the game has improved and grown so much thanks to all of your feedback and suggestions!

I'm really excited to announce that Patch 1.3 is available now! These are the updates:

Tweaks and new features

 Game feel improvements: Smoother camera and hit stop
 Some visual polish
 Balancing updates
 Rose now attacks with lasers instead of knives
 V-Sync is now on by default
 Reduced the strength of the brightness setting, and capped the minimum to 50%
 Improved pacing in chapter 3 and 4

New Content

 Added "Diamond Fruit" and "Chance Fruit"
 Added 2 new chests
 Added some new secrets

You can check out the full patch notes in the community forums here. If you have any suggestions or feedback, make sure to post it in the community forums or in a review! I might take it on board for a future update.

I hope you're holding up well during these weird times. Please be well, and thanks for everything. I hope you give the game a shot if you haven't already! Here's the trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0AlYpDLNVls

-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much to all of you that have played View From Below so far – it really means the world to me.

The game launched just over 2 months ago now, and thanks to your feedback and suggestions, it's continued to grow and improve, and become the best game it can possibly be.

I'm excited to announce that Update 1.2 was just released, and it contains a bunch of awesome new features:

 Bell's house is now accessible, should you manage to seek it out. In it, you can find out more about the mysterious character, as well as attempt to unlock his giant safe. But what's the combination? And what does it contain? You'll have to explore Below to find out…
 Glacies Cliffs now contains 5 hidden "Mana Berry Trees" which were planted by a quirky Mage. Find, pick, and eat from them, to boost your Max Mana stat!
 Many tweaks and QoL updates have been made to the game based on player feedback. These include some new menu and window designs, a new attack pattern for the Skelly enemy, and a dozen or so rarer bug fixes.


Here's the trailer once more:

[previewyoutube=0AlYpDLNVls;full][/previewyoutube]

I know that there's so much more important things going on right now in this intense, dramatic year. But maybe releasing a game about hope and kindness into it wasn't such a bad idea…

Stay safe out there,
-Jack.

notes.title: View From Below Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone who's played View From Below so far! It first released just over a month ago, and it's been really awesome to hear your thoughts on the game, as well as about the secrets you've come across and your theories on the lore.

Today I uploaded a major update that includes Steam achievements, online community leaderboards for the minigames, as well as an unlockable New Game+ mode called "Challenge+" ! I've also previously released smaller updates that have added graphical improvements, the ability to quickly skip evading minigames and much more!

Challenge+ makes enemies harder, items cost more and sell for less, and also includes some mode-exclusive lore. It's tricky, but not too tricky- I promise! If you manage to beat it, you also unlock a special achievement. Pretty nifty!

[previewyoutube=0AlYpDLNVls;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks so much for playing VIEW FROM BELOW. I hope the game has meant as much to you, as it's meant to me. If you haven't had a chance to get the game yet, now would be a really good time to play.

Stay safe out there.
- Jack
